name: Etash Guha
bio: Etash Guha is a researcher affiliated with Stanford University and a lead of the OpenThoughts project. They are first author of the OpenThoughts paper (ICLR 2026), which presents open data recipes for training reasoning models and the OpenThoughts3-7B model. Guha is also an author on DataComp-LM and Terminal-Bench.
known_for: First author of OpenThoughts data recipes paper
Co-author of DataComp-LM and MINT-1T datasets
